name: Inbound webhook
description: Get a private address. Other tools post to it, and TITAN turns each post into an event or a task.

auth.setupNote: TITAN makes the hook id and the secret for you. It shows the secret one time only. Choose how the sender proves itself: hmac, github, or static.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Name
fields.help: A short name that shows in the event list.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Check mode
fields.help: hmac signs the body and the time. github uses X-Hub-Signature-256. static sends the secret in a header and is weaker.

fields.name: target
fields.label: What a post does
fields.help: event goes to the notification rules. task makes a sub-agent task.

fields.name: task_brief
fields.label: Task brief
fields.help: Used when a post makes a task. Write {{body.field}} to insert a field of the post.
